title: Discover Glenorchy | Queenstown Official Website
facts: Glenorchy is reached on the Queenstown–Glenorchy Road; local transport operators also serve the area.
Official tourism information identifies Glenorchy Lagoon as a walking destination and the area as a gateway to longer tracks.
Glenorchy is near the northern end of Lake Wakatipu and is reached by the Queenstown–Glenorchy Road.
The area is a gateway to Routeburn, Greenstone and Caples tracks; these are distinct from a casual village and lagoon visit.
